Hi Aisha / FinHealth team 

Thanks for sending the VSA and for the clear questions. Quick answers below and attached items: redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf (executive summary) and redwood-vuln-management-sla.docx.

Redaction policy:
- We provide an executive pen test summary for procurement and security reviews. Full raw reports that include exploit PoCs, customer-identifying specifics, or detailed attack traces are only shared under a mutual NDA and secure transfer.
- Executive summaries include: scope, testing vendor, high-level findings by severity, mitigation status, and remediation timelines.

Vulnerability disclosure & remediation SLA (our standard):
- Critical: initial acknowledgement within 24 hours; mitigation plan within 48 hours; emergency patching cadence as needed.
- High: acknowledgement within 48 hours; remediation plan within 7 calendar days; target fix within 30 calendar days depending on complexity.
- Medium/Low: triage within 7 days; remediation per next release cycle.

Scanning cadence & evidence:
- External vulnerability scans: weekly automated scans, monthly authenticated scans, and quarterly manual pen tests by a third-party vendor (annual full-scope pen test).
- We maintain remediation tracking (Jira) and can provide a CSV export of outstanding items for audit if required.

Delivery options:
- We can upload the redacted executive summary and SLA to your SFTP as requested. For SOC 2 Type II documents or the unredacted pen test report, we require a signed mutual NDA and delivery over our secure portal.

Happy to jump on a quick call with your team to walk through the summary and answer questions.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf, redwood-vuln-management-sla.docx
